source.text: וַיְהִ֗י כִּשְׁמֹ֨עַ֙ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ חִזְקִיָּ֔הוּ וַיִּקְרַ֖ע אֶת־בְּגָדָ֑יו וַיִּתְכַּ֣ס בַּשָּׂ֔ק וַיָּבֹ֖א בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was, as heard the king Hezekiah, and he tore his clothes and covered himself with sackcloth and went [into the] house of Yahweh.

en.L: And it was, when King Hezekiah heard [it], [that] he tore his clothes and covered himself with sackcloth and went [into] the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: As soon as King Hezekiah heard it, he tore his clothes, wrapped himself in sackcloth, and entered the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: King Hezekiah heard the report of what the Assyrian commander had said. He tore his clothes and put on rough sackcloth to show his grief. Then he went into the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y sucedió que, cuando el rey Ezequías [lo] oyó, rasgó sus vestidos, y se cubrió de cilicio y entró [en] la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: En cuanto el rey Ezequías lo oyó, rasgó sus vestidos, se cubrió de cilicio y entró en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: El rey Ezequías oyó el informe de lo que había dicho el copero mayor. Rasgó su ropa y se puso un áspero cilicio en señal de dolor. Luego entró en el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et il arriva, quand le roi Ézéchias [l’]entendit, [qu’]il déchira ses vêtements, se couvrit d’un sac et entra [dans] la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Dès que le roi Ézéchias entendit cela, il déchira ses vêtements, se couvrit d’un sac et entra dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Le roi Ézéchias a entendu le rapport de ce que le grand échanson avait dit. Il a déchiré ses vêtements et il a mis un vêtement de sac pour montrer sa douleur. Puis il est entré dans le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Ikawa mfalme Hezekia aliposikia [hayo], akayararua mavazi yake, akajifunika kwa nguo ya magunia, akaingia [katika] nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Mara mfalme Hezekia aliposikia hayo, aliyararua mavazi yake, akajivika nguo ya magunia, akaingia katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Mfalme Hezekia alisikia habari ya yale aliyosema Rabshake. Akayararua mavazi yake, akavaa nguo ya magunia kuonyesha huzuni yake. Kisha akaingia katika hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Xảy ra, khi vua Ê-xê-chia nghe [điều ấy], thì vua xé áo mình, khoác vải thô và đi [vào] nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Vừa nghe điều ấy, vua Ê-xê-chia xé áo mình, khoác vải thô và đi vào nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Vua Ê-xê-chia nghe tâu lại những lời viên chỉ huy A-si-ri đã nói. Vua xé áo mình và mặc vải thô để tỏ lòng đau buồn. Rồi vua đi vào đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 그리고 히스기야 왕이 [그것을] 듣고서, 자기 옷을 찢고 굵은 베로 몸을 덮고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집으로 들어갔다.
ko.B: 히스기야 왕은 그 말을 듣자마자 자기 옷을 찢고 굵은 베옷을 두르고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집으로 들어갔다.
ko.R: 히스기야 왕은 랍사게가 한 말을 전해 들었다. 그는 슬픔을 나타내려고 자기 옷을 찢고 거친 베옷을 입었다. 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전으로 들어갔다.

decisions.choice: the story continues from 18:37 and runs parallel to Isaiah 37:1-38
decisions.reason: 2 Kings 18:13-20:19 closely matches Isaiah 36-39, and this verse is the same as Isaiah 37:1. What Hezekiah heard is the report his officials brought back from the Rabshakeh (18:37). Each verse of this chapter notes where its wording differs from Isaiah 37.

decisions.choice: tearing clothes and wearing sackcloth: signs of grief and of humbling oneself before God
decisions.reason: Sackcloth was a rough cloth of goat or camel hair worn in mourning and repentance (Isaiah 22:12; Jonah 3:6). The king goes at once to the house of the LORD to seek help.

decisions.choice: the report of what the Assyrian commander had said; to show his grief
decisions.reason: Readable says what Hezekiah heard (18:37) and what the gestures meant.

decisions.choice: "cilicio"
decisions.reason: "Cilicio" for sackcloth at every level, as the Samuel terms note sets; Readable says what the gestures meant, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "se couvrit d'un sac" (L, B); "a mis un vêtement de sac" (R)
decisions.reason: The sackcloth of mourning (m2) is "le sac" as the Samuel terms note sets; Readable says it was a garment.

decisions.choice: "굵은 베" (L), "굵은 베옷" (B), "거친 베옷" (R)
decisions.reason: The Samuel note's word for sackcloth; Readable uses the plainer adjective.

source.text: וַ֠יִּשְׁלַח אֶת־אֶלְיָקִ֨ים אֲשֶׁר־עַל־הַבַּ֜יִת וְשֶׁבְנָ֣א הַסֹּפֵ֗ר וְאֵת֙ זִקְנֵ֣י הַכֹּֽהֲנִ֔ים מִתְכַּסִּ֖ים בַּשַּׂקִּ֑ים אֶל־יְשַֽׁעְיָ֥הוּ הַנָּבִ֖יא בֶּן־אָמֽוֹץ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he sent Eliakim who [was] over the house and Shebna the secretary and [the] elders of the priests, covered with sackcloth, to Isaiah the prophet son of Amoz.

en.L: And he sent Eliakim, who [was] over the house, and Shebna the secretary, and the elders of the priests, covered with sackcloth, to Isaiah the prophet, son of Amoz.
en.B: He sent Eliakim, who was in charge of the palace, Shebna the secretary, and the senior priests, all clothed in sackcloth, to the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz.
en.R: He sent Eliakim, the man in charge of the palace, Shebna the royal secretary, and the leading priests to the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz. They were all wearing sackcloth.

es.L: Y envió a Eliaquim, que [estaba] sobre la casa, y a Sebna el secretario, y a los ancianos de los sacerdotes, cubiertos de cilicio, al profeta Isaías hijo de Amoz.
es.B: Envió a Eliaquim, el mayordomo del palacio, a Sebna el secretario y a los sacerdotes de más edad, todos vestidos de cilicio, al profeta Isaías hijo de Amoz.
es.R: Envió a Eliaquim, el mayordomo del palacio; a Sebna, el secretario del rey; y a los sacerdotes principales a ver al profeta Isaías hijo de Amoz. Todos iban vestidos de cilicio.

fr.L: Et il envoya Éliaqim, qui [était] le chef du palais, Shebna le secrétaire et les anciens des prêtres, couverts de sacs, vers Isaïe le prophète, fils d’Amots.
fr.B: Il envoya Éliaqim, le chef du palais, Shebna, le secrétaire, et les plus anciens des prêtres, tous couverts de sacs, auprès du prophète Isaïe, fils d’Amots.
fr.R: Il a envoyé Éliaqim, qui dirigeait le palais, Shebna, le secrétaire du roi, et les principaux prêtres auprès du prophète Isaïe fils d’Amots. Ils portaient tous des vêtements de sac.

sw.L: Naye akamtuma Eliakimu, aliyekuwa msimamizi wa ikulu, na Shebna katibu, na wazee wa makuhani, wamejifunika kwa nguo za magunia, kwa Isaya nabii, mwana wa Amozi.
sw.B: Akamtuma Eliakimu, msimamizi wa ikulu, Shebna katibu, na makuhani wazee, wote wakiwa wamevaa nguo za magunia, kwa nabii Isaya mwana wa Amozi.
sw.R: Akawatuma Eliakimu, msimamizi wa jumba la mfalme, Shebna katibu wa mfalme, na viongozi wa makuhani kwa nabii Isaya mwana wa Amozi. Wote walikuwa wamevaa nguo za magunia.

vi.L: Vua sai Ê-li-a-kim, quan cai quản cung điện, Sép-na thư ký, và các trưởng lão trong hàng thầy tế lễ, khoác vải thô, đến gặp nhà tiên tri Ê-sai con trai A-mốt.
vi.B: Vua sai Ê-li-a-kim, quan cai quản cung điện, Sép-na thư ký, và các thầy tế lễ cao niên, tất cả đều khoác vải thô, đến gặp nhà tiên tri Ê-sai con trai A-mốt.
vi.R: Vua sai Ê-li-a-kim, quan cai quản cung điện, Sép-na, thư ký của vua, và các thầy tế lễ lãnh đạo đến gặp nhà tiên tri Ê-sai con trai A-mốt. Tất cả đều mặc vải thô.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 궁내 대신 엘리아김과 서기관 셉나와 제사장들의 장로들을 굵은 베로 몸을 덮은 채 아모스의 아들 예언자 이사야에게 보냈다.
ko.B: 그는 궁내 대신 엘리아김과 서기관 셉나와 원로 제사장들에게 모두 굵은 베옷을 입혀, 아모스의 아들 예언자 이사야에게 보냈다.
ko.R: 그는 왕궁 일을 맡은 엘리아김과 왕의 서기관 셉나와 지도자 제사장들을 아모스의 아들 예언자 이사야에게 보냈다. 그들은 모두 거친 베옷을 입고 있었다.

decisions.choice: over the house: the chief steward of the palace; the secretary: the royal scribe
decisions.reason: These are the same officials who met the Rabshakeh (18:18). Eliakim had been given Shebna's post as steward (Isaiah 22:15-22); Shebna now serves as the king's secretary, who wrote and kept the royal records.

decisions.choice: the elders of the priests: the senior priests
decisions.reason: The phrase means the leading or older priests, not a separate council (Isaiah 37:2; Jeremiah 19:1).

decisions.choice: parallel to Isaiah 37:2, with "the prophet" before "son of Amoz"
decisions.reason: Isaiah 37:2 reads "Isaiah son of Amoz, the prophet"; here the title comes first. The meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: "Isaías hijo de Amoz"
decisions.reason: As the terms note's table gives it.

decisions.choice: Isaïe fils d'Amots
decisions.reason: The usual French form, as the terms note sets and the French New Testament has it.

decisions.choice: "아모스의 아들 예언자 이사야"
decisions.reason: The terms note's form; Korean Protestant tradition spells Isaiah's father like the prophet Amos, though the Hebrew names differ.

source.text: וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלָ֗יו כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר חִזְקִיָּ֔הוּ יוֹם־צָרָ֧ה וְתוֹכֵחָ֛ה וּנְאָצָ֖ה הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה כִּ֣י בָ֤אוּ בָנִים֙ עַד־מַשְׁבֵּ֔ר וְכֹ֥חַ אַ֖יִן לְלֵדָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And they said to him, Thus says Hezekiah: a day of distress and rebuke and disgrace [is] the day this, for have come children to [the] opening [of the womb] and strength there is not to give birth.

en.L: And they said to him, "Thus says Hezekiah: A day of distress and rebuke and disgrace [is] this day, for children have come to the opening [of the womb], and [there is] no strength to give birth.
en.B: They said to him, "Hezekiah says this: Today is a day of distress, of rebuke and of disgrace. Children have reached the opening of the womb, and there is no strength to bring them to birth.
en.R: They said to Isaiah, "This is what Hezekiah says: Today is a day of trouble. We are being punished and put to shame. We are like a woman whose baby is ready to be born, but she has no strength left to give birth.

es.L: Y le dijeron: «Así dice Ezequías: Día de angustia, de reprensión y de afrenta [es] este día, porque los hijos han llegado hasta la abertura [del vientre], y no [hay] fuerza para dar a luz.
es.B: Le dijeron: «Ezequías dice esto: Hoy es un día de angustia, de reprensión y de vergüenza. Los hijos han llegado al momento de nacer, y no hay fuerzas para darlos a luz.
es.R: Le dijeron a Isaías: «Esto es lo que dice Ezequías: Hoy es un día de angustia. Estamos siendo castigados y humillados. Somos como una mujer cuyo bebé está a punto de nacer, pero que ya no tiene fuerzas para dar a luz.

fr.L: Et ils lui dirent : « Ainsi parle Ézéchias : Ce jour [est] un jour de détresse, de châtiment et d’opprobre, car les enfants sont venus jusqu’à l’ouverture [du sein], et [il n’y a] pas de force pour enfanter.
fr.B: Ils lui dirent : « Ézéchias dit ceci : Aujourd’hui est un jour de détresse, de châtiment et de honte. Les enfants sont arrivés au moment de naître, et la force manque pour les mettre au monde.
fr.R: Ils ont dit à Isaïe : « Voici ce que dit Ézéchias : Aujourd’hui est un jour de malheur. Nous sommes punis et couverts de honte. Nous sommes comme une femme dont le bébé est prêt à naître, mais qui n’a plus la force d’accoucher.

sw.L: Nao wakamwambia, "Hivi ndivyo asemavyo Hezekia: Siku hii ni siku ya taabu na ya karipio na ya aibu, kwa maana watoto wamefika mlangoni [pa tumbo la uzazi], wala hakuna nguvu ya kuzaa.
sw.B: Wakamwambia, "Hezekia asema hivi: Leo ni siku ya taabu, ya karipio na ya aibu. Watoto wamefika mlangoni pa tumbo la uzazi, wala hakuna nguvu ya kuwazaa.
sw.R: Wakamwambia Isaya, "Hiki ndicho Hezekia anachosema: Leo ni siku ya shida. Tunaadhibiwa na kuaibishwa. Tuko kama mwanamke ambaye mtoto wake yuko tayari kuzaliwa, lakini hana nguvu tena za kumzaa.

vi.L: Họ nói với ông: "Ê-xê-chia nói thế này: Ngày nay [là] ngày hoạn nạn, quở phạt và nhục nhã, vì con cái đã đến lúc lọt lòng, mà không có sức để sinh ra.
vi.B: Họ nói với ông: "Ê-xê-chia nói như vầy: Hôm nay là ngày hoạn nạn, ngày bị quở phạt và nhục nhã. Con đã đến lúc lọt lòng, mà người mẹ không còn sức để sinh.
vi.R: Họ nói với Ê-sai: "Vua Ê-xê-chia nói thế này: Hôm nay là ngày khốn khó. Chúng tôi đang bị trừng phạt và bị sỉ nhục. Chúng tôi giống như người đàn bà sắp sinh con mà không còn sức để sinh.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 그에게 말했다. "히스기야께서 이와 같이 말씀하십니다. '오늘은 환난과 책망과 모욕의 날입니다. 아이들이 [태의] 문에 이르렀으나 낳을 힘이 없습니다.
ko.B: 그들이 이사야에게 말했다. "히스기야 임금님께서 이렇게 말씀하십니다. '오늘은 환난과 징계와 치욕의 날입니다. 아이가 태어나려고 태의 문에 이르렀는데 해산할 힘이 없습니다.
ko.R: 그들이 이사야에게 말했다. "히스기야 임금님께서 이렇게 말씀하십니다. '오늘은 괴로운 날입니다. 우리는 벌을 받고 수치를 당하고 있습니다. 우리는 아기를 낳으려는데 힘이 다 빠져 버린 여자와 같습니다.

decisions.choice: rebuke: correction or punishment that brings shame
decisions.reason: The word is used for God's stern correction (Hosea 5:9). Here it may also include the enemy's insults, which the next word, disgrace, picks up.

decisions.choice: children have come to the opening of the womb: a crisis at its decisive moment with no power to finish it
decisions.reason: A birth that has come to the last stage but cannot be completed means danger of death for mother and child (Hosea 13:13). Judah is at the point of crisis and helpless to come through it.

decisions.choice: parallel to Isaiah 37:3
decisions.reason: The Hebrew of this verse is the same as Isaiah 37:3, and the wording here follows it.

decisions.choice: We are like a woman whose baby is ready to be born
decisions.reason: Readable turns the image into a stated comparison so the reader sees what it describes.

decisions.choice: The officials speak to Isaiah in the formal style (합쇼체) and give the king's words with honorifics ("말씀하십니다"); Hezekiah's own message is also 합쇼체
decisions.reason: The king humbles himself and asks the prophet to pray; Korean shows the king's respect for Isaiah in the speech level of his message.

source.text: אוּלַ֡י יִשְׁמַע֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ אֵ֣ת׀כָּל־דִּבְרֵ֣י רַב־שָׁקֵ֗ה אֲשֶׁר֩ שְׁלָח֨וֹ מֶֽלֶךְ־אַשּׁ֤וּר׀אֲדֹנָיו֙ לְחָרֵף֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים חַ֔י וְהוֹכִ֨יחַ֙ בַּדְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁמַ֖ע יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ וְנָשָׂ֣אתָ תְפִלָּ֔ה בְּעַ֥ד הַשְּׁאֵרִ֖ית הַנִּמְצָאָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Perhaps will hear Yahweh your God all [the] words of [the] Rabshakeh whom has sent him the king of Assyria his master to taunt [the] God living, and he will rebuke [him for] the words that has heard Yahweh your God; and you will lift up prayer for the remnant that is found.

en.L: Perhaps {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God will hear all the words of the Rabshakeh, whom the king of Assyria, his master, has sent to taunt the living God, and will rebuke [him for] the words that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God has heard. And lift up a prayer for the remnant that is found."
en.B: Perhaps {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God will hear everything the chief officer said when his master the king of Assyria sent him to insult the living God, and will call him to account for the words {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God has heard. Lift up a prayer, then, for the remnant that is still here."
en.R: Maybe {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God will pay attention to everything the Assyrian commander said. His master, the king of Assyria, sent him to insult the living God. Maybe {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God will punish him for what he said. So please pray for those of us who are still left."

es.L: Tal vez {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios oirá todas las palabras del Rabsaces, a quien el rey de Asiria, su señor, ha enviado para afrentar al Dios vivo, y [lo] reprenderá por las palabras que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios ha oído. Eleva, pues, una oración por el remanente que aún queda».
es.B: Tal vez {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios oiga todo lo que dijo el copero mayor, a quien su señor, el rey de Asiria, envió para insultar al Dios vivo, y le pida cuentas por las palabras que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios ha oído. Eleva, pues, una oración por el remanente que todavía queda».
es.R: Tal vez {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios preste atención a todo lo que dijo el copero mayor. Su señor, el rey de Asiria, lo envió a insultar al Dios vivo. Tal vez {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios lo castigue por lo que dijo. Así que, por favor, ora por los que todavía quedamos».

fr.L: Peut-être {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu entendra-t-il toutes les paroles du Rabshaqé, que le roi d’Assyrie, son maître, a envoyé pour insulter le Dieu vivant, et le punira-t-il pour les paroles que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu a entendues. Élève donc une prière pour le reste qui se trouve [encore là]. »
fr.B: Peut-être {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu entendra-t-il tout ce qu’a dit le grand échanson, que son maître, le roi d’Assyrie, a envoyé pour insulter le Dieu vivant, et lui demandera-t-il des comptes pour les paroles que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu a entendues. Élève donc une prière pour le reste qui subsiste encore. »
fr.R: Peut-être {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu fera-t-il attention à tout ce qu’a dit le grand échanson. Son maître, le roi d’Assyrie, l’a envoyé insulter le Dieu vivant. Peut-être {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu le punira-t-il pour ce qu’il a dit. Alors, s’il te plaît, prie pour ceux d’entre nous qui sont encore en vie. »

sw.L: Huenda {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako atayasikia maneno yote ya Rabshake, ambaye mfalme wa Ashuru, bwana wake, amemtuma kumtukana Mungu aliye hai, naye atamkemea [kwa ajili ya] maneno ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako ameyasikia. Basi inua maombi kwa ajili ya mabaki yaliyopo."
sw.B: Huenda {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako atayasikia maneno yote ya Rabshake, ambaye bwana wake mfalme wa Ashuru alimtuma kumtukana Mungu aliye hai, naye atamwadhibu kwa maneno ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako ameyasikia. Basi inua maombi kwa ajili ya mabaki ambao bado wako hapa."
sw.R: Labda {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako atayasikiliza maneno yote aliyosema Rabshake. Bwana wake, mfalme wa Ashuru, alimtuma amtukane Mungu aliye hai. Labda {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako atamwadhibu kwa maneno aliyosema. Kwa hiyo tafadhali utuombee sisi tuliobaki."

vi.L: Có lẽ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ông sẽ nghe mọi lời của Ráp-sa-kê, kẻ mà vua A-si-ri, chủ hắn, đã sai đến để sỉ nhục Đức Chúa Trời hằng sống, và sẽ quở phạt [hắn vì] những lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ông đã nghe. Vậy xin ông dâng lời cầu nguyện cho số người sót lại còn đây."
vi.B: Có lẽ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ông sẽ nghe mọi lời viên quan trưởng đã nói, khi chủ hắn là vua A-si-ri sai hắn đến sỉ nhục Đức Chúa Trời hằng sống, và Ngài sẽ bắt hắn chịu trách nhiệm về những lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ông đã nghe. Vậy xin ông cầu nguyện cho số người sót lại còn ở đây."
vi.R: Có lẽ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ông sẽ để ý đến mọi lời viên chỉ huy A-si-ri đã nói. Chủ hắn là vua A-si-ri đã sai hắn đến sỉ nhục Đức Chúa Trời hằng sống. Có lẽ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ông sẽ phạt hắn vì những lời hắn đã nói. Vậy xin ông cầu nguyện cho những người trong chúng tôi còn sót lại."

ko.L: 혹시 선생님의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 랍사게의 모든 말을 들으셨을지 모릅니다. 그의 주인 앗시리아 왕이 살아 계신 하나님을 조롱하라고 그를 보냈으니, 선생님의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 들으신 그 말 때문에 [그를] 꾸짖으실지 모릅니다. 그러니 남아 있는 사람들을 위하여 기도를 올려 주십시오.'"
ko.B: 그의 주인 앗시리아 왕이 살아 계신 하나님을 모욕하라고 랍사게를 보냈습니다. 선생님의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 혹시 그가 한 말을 다 들으시고, 그 들으신 말 때문에 그를 벌하실지도 모릅니다. 그러니 아직 남아 있는 사람들을 위하여 기도해 주십시오.'"
ko.R: 혹시 선생님의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 랍사게가 한 말을 다 들으셨을지도 모릅니다. 그의 주인 앗시리아 왕이 그를 보내어 살아 계신 하나님을 모욕하게 했습니다. 선생님의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그 말 때문에 그를 벌하실지도 모릅니다. 그러니 아직 살아남은 우리를 위해 기도해 주십시오.'"

decisions.choice: the living God: the God who acts, unlike the lifeless gods of the nations
decisions.reason: To insult the living God is to treat him like the idols Assyria has burned (verse 18; 1 Samuel 17:26). The phrase returns in Hezekiah's prayer (verse 16).

decisions.choice: the remnant that is found: those still left in Jerusalem
decisions.reason: Assyria had already taken the fortified towns of Judah (18:13). Only Jerusalem and the people in it remained.

decisions.choice: parallel to Isaiah 37:4, adding "all" before "the words"
decisions.reason: Isaiah 37:4 reads "the words of the Rabshakeh"; Kings reads "all the words". Otherwise the verse is the same.

decisions.choice: the Rabshakeh (L); the chief officer (B); the Assyrian commander (R)
decisions.reason: An Assyrian title (see 18:17). Literal keeps the title; Balanced and Readable give its sense.

decisions.choice: call him to account
decisions.reason: The verb means to rebuke or punish; Balanced uses a phrase that covers both.

decisions.choice: "el Rabsaces" (L); "el copero mayor" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in 18:17: Literal keeps the title, Balanced and Readable say "el copero mayor", as the Kings and Chronicles terms note sets.

decisions.choice: "tu" to Isaiah
decisions.reason: The king's envoys speak to the prophet with "tu", as one person is addressed with "tu" in these drafts; respect is carried by the words, not by "vous".

decisions.choice: the king's men to Isaiah: ông; Đức Chúa Trời của ông
decisions.reason: Hezekiah's officials speak to the prophet with respect, "ông", as people speak to a prophet in Samuel; the king's own words are reported in the third person.

decisions.choice: "선생님의 하나님" for "your God" said to the prophet
decisions.reason: The king's men address the prophet with respect; "선생님" is the courteous title for a teacher or man of God, where "당신" would sound cold.

en.L: And the servants of King Hezekiah came to Isaiah.
en.B: So King Hezekiah's officials came to Isaiah.
en.R: So King Hezekiah's officials went to Isaiah.

es.L: Y vinieron los siervos del rey Ezequías a Isaías.
es.B: Así que los funcionarios del rey Ezequías fueron a ver a Isaías.
es.R: Así que los funcionarios del rey Ezequías fueron a ver a Isaías.

fr.L: Et les serviteurs du roi Ézéchias vinrent auprès d’Isaïe.
fr.B: Les officiers du roi Ézéchias vinrent donc auprès d’Isaïe.
fr.R: Les officiers du roi Ézéchias sont donc allés voir Isaïe.

sw.L: Nao watumishi wa mfalme Hezekia wakaja kwa Isaya.
sw.B: Basi maafisa wa mfalme Hezekia walikuja kwa Isaya.
sw.R: Basi maafisa wa mfalme Hezekia walikwenda kwa Isaya.

vi.B: Vậy các triều thần của vua Ê-xê-chia đến gặp Ê-sai.
vi.R: Vậy các quan chức của vua Ê-xê-chia đi đến gặp Ê-sai.

ko.L: 그리고 히스기야 왕의 신하들이 이사야에게 왔다.
ko.B: 이렇게 히스기야 왕의 신하들이 이사야에게 왔다.
ko.R: 이렇게 히스기야 왕의 신하들이 이사야에게 갔다.

decisions.choice: they came: a summary of the visit already told in verses 2-4
decisions.reason: The narrator returns to the action after giving the officials' message, and verse 6 gives Isaiah's answer.

decisions.choice: parallel to Isaiah 37:5
decisions.reason: The Hebrew of this verse is the same as Isaiah 37:5, and the wording here follows it.

decisions.choice: officials
decisions.reason: The king's servants are his court officials, the men he sent in verse 2.

decisions.choice: "funcionarios"
decisions.reason: The king's servants are his court officials, the men sent in verse 2; Literal keeps "siervos".

source.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לָהֶם֙ יְשַֽׁעְיָ֔הוּ כֹּ֥ה תֹאמְר֖וּן אֶל־אֲדֹֽנֵיכֶ֑ם כֹּ֣ה׀אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה אַל־תִּירָא֙ מִפְּנֵ֤י הַדְּבָרִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁמַ֗עְתָּ אֲשֶׁ֧ר גִּדְּפ֛וּ נַעֲרֵ֥י מֶֽלֶךְ־אַשּׁ֖וּר אֹתִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And said to them Isaiah, Thus you will say to your master: thus says Yahweh, Do not be afraid of the words that you have heard, which have blasphemed the young men of the king of Assyria me.

en.L: And Isaiah said to them, "Thus you will say to your master: 'Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: Do not be afraid because of the words that you have heard, with which the young men of the king of Assyria have blasphemed {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.
en.B: Isaiah said to them, "Say to your master, '{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} says this: Do not be frightened by what you have heard, the words with which the king of Assyria's lackeys have reviled {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.
en.R: Isaiah said to them, "Tell your master, 'This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: Do not let the words you heard frighten you. The king of Assyria's men have insulted {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.

es.L: E Isaías les dijo: «Así {{plural_you:dirán|diréis}} a {{plural_you:su señor|vuestro señor}}: “Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: No temas por las palabras que has oído, con las que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} han blasfemado los criados del rey de Asiria.
es.B: Isaías les dijo: «{{plural_you:Díganle|Decidle}} a {{plural_you:su señor|vuestro señor}}: “{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto: No te asustes por lo que has oído, por las palabras con que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} han insultado los lacayos del rey de Asiria.
es.R: Isaías les dijo: «{{plural_you:Díganle|Decidle}} a {{plural_you:su señor|vuestro señor}}: “Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: No dejes que te asusten las palabras que oíste. Los hombres del rey de Asiria {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} han insultado.

fr.L: Et Isaïe leur dit : « Vous direz ainsi à votre maître : “Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : N’aie pas peur des paroles que tu as entendues, par lesquelles les jeunes gens du roi d’Assyrie {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}ont insulté.
fr.B: Isaïe leur dit : « Dites à votre maître : “{{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci : Ne sois pas effrayé par ce que tu as entendu, par les paroles injurieuses que les valets du roi d’Assyrie ont prononcées contre {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}.
fr.R: Isaïe leur a répondu : « Dites à votre maître : “Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : Ne te laisse pas effrayer par les paroles que tu as entendues. Les hommes du roi d’Assyrie {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}ont insulté.

sw.L: Naye Isaya akawaambia, "Hivi ndivyo mtakavyomwambia bwana wenu: '{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Usiogope kwa sababu ya maneno uliyoyasikia, ambayo vijana wa mfalme wa Ashuru wamenikufuru kwayo.
sw.B: Isaya akawaambia, "Mwambieni bwana wenu, 'Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Usiogope kwa sababu ya maneno uliyoyasikia, ambayo vibaraka wa mfalme wa Ashuru wamenitukana kwayo.
sw.R: Isaya akawaambia, "Mwambieni bwana wenu, 'Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema: Usiogope maneno uliyoyasikia. Watu wa mfalme wa Ashuru wamenitukana.

vi.L: Ê-sai nói với họ: "Các ông hãy nói với chủ mình thế này: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: Đừng sợ vì những lời ngươi đã nghe, là những lời bọn đầy tớ của vua A-si-ri đã phạm thượng đến {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.B: Ê-sai nói với họ: "Hãy nói với chủ các ông: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: Đừng sợ những lời con đã nghe, là những lời bọn tay sai của vua A-si-ri đã xúc phạm {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.R: Ê-sai nói với họ: "Hãy nói với chủ các ông: 'Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: Đừng để những lời con đã nghe làm con sợ hãi. Bọn người của vua A-si-ri đã sỉ nhục {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.

ko.L: 그리고 이사야가 그들에게 말했다. "여러분의 주인에게 이와 같이 말하십시오. '{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 앗시리아 왕의 젊은 졸개들이 나를 모독한 말, 네가 들은 그 말들 때문에 두려워하지 마라.
ko.B: 이사야가 그들에게 말했다. "여러분의 주인께 이렇게 전하십시오. '{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 네가 들은 말, 곧 앗시리아 왕의 졸개들이 나를 모욕한 말 때문에 두려워하지 마라.
ko.R: 이사야가 그들에게 말했다. "여러분의 주인께 이렇게 전하십시오. '{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 네가 들은 말 때문에 겁내지 마라. 앗시리아 왕의 부하들이 나를 모욕했다.

decisions.choice: the young men: a scornful word for the Assyrian envoys
decisions.reason: The word means boys or attendants. God does not call them servants or officials, as Hezekiah's men are called (verse 5), but treats them as mere underlings.

decisions.choice: blasphemed: insulted God with words
decisions.reason: The same verb is used in verse 22. The envoys' speech (18:33-35) put the LORD on a level with the gods that had failed.

decisions.choice: parallel to Isaiah 37:6
decisions.reason: The Hebrew of this verse is the same as Isaiah 37:6, apart from another form of the word "to" and small differences of spelling, and the wording here follows it.

decisions.choice: lackeys
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the scorn of the word; Literal keeps its plain sense.

decisions.choice: "criados" (L); "lacayos" (B); "los hombres" (R)
decisions.reason: The scornful word for the envoys (m1): Literal "criados", Balanced keeps the scorn with "lacayos", Readable says "hombres", as the English levels do.

decisions.choice: "Así dice el SEÑOR" (L); "El SEÑOR dice esto" (B); "Esto es lo que dice el SEÑOR" (R)
decisions.reason: The messenger formula as the Samuel terms note sets it for Spanish.

decisions.choice: "les valets" (B); "les hommes" (R)
decisions.reason: The word is scornful (m1); "valets" carries the contempt, as the English "lackeys" does.

decisions.choice: vijana (Literal); vibaraka (Balanced); watu wa mfalme (Readable)
decisions.reason: The word is a scornful one for the envoys, "boys" (meaning decision m1); Balanced uses "vibaraka", lackeys. The English deity pronoun on "me" falls on the verb's object marker "-ni-" in Swahili, which takes no span.

decisions.choice: CHÚA phán thế này (L); như vầy (B); Đây là lời CHÚA phán (R); God to Hezekiah: ngươi (L), con (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Thus says the LORD" keeps the Samuel wording at each level. God speaks to the king who sought him as "ngươi" at Literal and "con" at Balanced and Readable, as God speaks to his own in Genesis and Samuel.

decisions.choice: Isaiah to the officials: 합쇼체 with "여러분"; the LORD's word in the plain style (해라체) with "나" and "너"
alternatives: Isaiah in 해라체 to the officials
decisions.reason: The prophet answers the king's envoys courteously; inside the oracle God speaks as everywhere, in the plain style.

decisions.choice: "젊은 졸개들" (L); "졸개들" (B); "부하들" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word "young men" is scornful here (meaning decision m1); "졸개" carries the contempt.

source.text: הִנְנִ֨י נֹתֵ֥ן בּוֹ֙ ר֔וּחַ וְשָׁמַ֥ע שְׁמוּעָ֖ה וְשָׁ֣ב לְאַרְצ֑וֹ וְהִפַּלְתִּ֥יו בַּחֶ֖רֶב בְּאַרְצֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Here I [am] putting in him a spirit, and he will hear a report and he will return to his land, and I will make him fall by the sword in his land.

en.L: Look, I am putting a spirit in him, and he will hear a report and return to his land, and I will make him fall by the sword in his land.'"
en.B: I am about to put a spirit in him: he will hear a rumor and go back to his own country, and in his own country I will make him fall by the sword.'"
en.R: Listen! I will make him want to leave. He will hear a report and go back to his own country. And there in his own country I will have him killed with a sword.'"

es.L: He aquí que yo pongo en él un espíritu, y oirá un rumor y volverá a su tierra, y lo haré caer a espada en su tierra”».
es.B: Voy a poner en él un espíritu: oirá un rumor y regresará a su propio país, y en su propio país lo haré caer a espada”».
es.R: ¡Escucha! Haré que quiera irse. Oirá una noticia y regresará a su propio país. Y allí, en su propio país, haré que lo maten a espada”».

fr.L: Voici, je mets en lui un esprit, et il entendra une nouvelle et retournera dans son pays, et je le ferai tomber par l’épée dans son pays.” »
fr.B: Je vais mettre en lui un esprit : il entendra une rumeur et retournera dans son pays, et dans son pays je le ferai tomber par l’épée.” »
fr.R: Écoute ! Je vais lui donner l’envie de partir. Il entendra une nouvelle et il rentrera dans son pays. Et là, dans son propre pays, je le ferai tuer par l’épée.” »

sw.L: Tazama, ninatia roho ndani yake, naye atasikia habari, na kurudi katika nchi yake, nami nitamwangusha kwa upanga katika nchi yake.'"
sw.B: Nitatia roho ndani yake: atasikia habari na kurudi katika nchi yake mwenyewe, nami nitamwangusha kwa upanga katika nchi yake mwenyewe.'"
sw.R: Sikiliza! Nitamfanya atake kuondoka. Atasikia habari fulani, naye atarudi katika nchi yake. Na huko katika nchi yake mwenyewe nitamfanya auawe kwa upanga.'"

vi.L: Này, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đặt một thần trong nó, nó sẽ nghe một tin đồn và trở về xứ mình, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ khiến nó ngã dưới gươm tại xứ nó.'"
vi.B: Này, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đặt một thần linh trong nó: nó sẽ nghe một tin đồn mà trở về xứ mình, và tại chính xứ mình {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ khiến nó ngã dưới lưỡi gươm.'"
vi.R: Hãy nghe! Ta sẽ khiến nó muốn bỏ đi. Nó sẽ nghe một tin tức và trở về xứ mình. Rồi tại chính xứ mình, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ khiến nó bị giết bằng gươm.'"

ko.L: 보아라, 내가 그에게 한 영을 넣겠다. 그러면 그가 소문을 듣고 자기 땅으로 돌아갈 것이다. 그리고 내가 그를 그의 땅에서 칼에 쓰러지게 하겠다.'"
ko.B: 내가 그에게 한 영을 넣어, 그가 어떤 소문을 듣고 자기 나라로 돌아가게 하겠다. 그리고 그의 나라에서 내가 그를 칼에 쓰러지게 하겠다.'"
ko.R: 들어라! 내가 그가 떠나고 싶어지게 만들겠다. 그는 어떤 소식을 듣고 자기 나라로 돌아갈 것이다. 그리고 바로 그의 나라에서 내가 그를 칼에 죽게 하겠다.'"

decisions.choice: a spirit: an impulse or frame of mind that God puts in him
decisions.reason: God moves the king's will from within (Isaiah 19:14; 1 Kings 22:22). It need not be fear, but it makes him turn for home.

decisions.choice: the report and the sword: both come true later in the chapter
decisions.reason: He hears news about Tirhakah (verse 9), returns home (verse 36), and dies by the sword in his own land (verse 37).

decisions.choice: parallel to Isaiah 37:7
decisions.reason: The Hebrew of this verse is the same as Isaiah 37:7, apart from another form of the word "to", and the wording here follows it.

decisions.choice: I will make him want to leave
decisions.reason: Readable states what the spirit does in this story.

source.text: וַיָּ֨שָׁב֙ רַב־שָׁקֵ֔ה וַיִּמְצָא֙ אֶת־מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר נִלְחָ֖ם עַל־לִבְנָ֑ה כִּ֣י שָׁמַ֔ע כִּ֥י נָסַ֖ע מִלָּכִֽישׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: And returned [the] Rabshakeh and found the king of Assyria fighting against Libnah, for he had heard that he had set out from Lachish.

en.L: And the Rabshakeh returned and found the king of Assyria fighting against Libnah, for he had heard that he had set out from Lachish.
en.B: The chief officer went back and found the king of Assyria attacking Libnah, for he had heard that the king had left Lachish.
en.R: The Assyrian commander went back to the king of Assyria. He had heard that the king had left the town of Lachish. He found him fighting against the town of Libnah.

es.L: Y el Rabsaces volvió y halló al rey de Asiria combatiendo contra Libna, porque había oído que se había ido de Laquis.
es.B: El copero mayor regresó y encontró al rey de Asiria atacando Libna, porque había oído que el rey se había ido de Laquis.
es.R: El copero mayor regresó a donde estaba el rey de Asiria. Había oído que el rey se había ido de la ciudad de Laquis. Lo encontró combatiendo contra la ciudad de Libna.

fr.L: Et le Rabshaqé s’en retourna et trouva le roi d’Assyrie combattant contre Libna, car il avait appris qu’il était parti de Lakish.
fr.B: Le grand échanson s’en retourna et trouva le roi d’Assyrie en train d’attaquer Libna, car il avait appris que le roi avait quitté Lakish.
fr.R: Le grand échanson est retourné auprès du roi d’Assyrie. Il avait appris que le roi avait quitté la ville de Lakish. Il l’a trouvé en train d’attaquer la ville de Libna.

sw.L: Naye Rabshake akarudi, akamkuta mfalme wa Ashuru akipigana na Libna, kwa maana alikuwa amesikia kwamba ameondoka Lakishi.
sw.B: Rabshake alirudi, akamkuta mfalme wa Ashuru akiishambulia Libna, kwa sababu alikuwa amesikia kwamba mfalme ameondoka Lakishi.
sw.R: Rabshake alirudi kwa mfalme wa Ashuru. Alikuwa amesikia kwamba mfalme ameondoka katika mji wa Lakishi. Akamkuta akipigana na mji wa Libna.

vi.L: Ráp-sa-kê trở về và thấy vua A-si-ri đang đánh Líp-na, vì hắn đã nghe rằng vua đã rời La-ki.

vi.R: Viên chỉ huy A-si-ri quay về với vua A-si-ri. Hắn đã nghe tin vua đã rời thành La-ki. Hắn thấy vua đang đánh thành Líp-na.

ko.L: 그리고 랍사게가 돌아가서, 앗시리아 왕이 립나를 치며 싸우고 있는 것을 보았다. 그가 [왕이] 라기스를 떠났다는 소식을 들었기 때문이다.
ko.B: 랍사게는 돌아가서 앗시리아 왕이 립나를 공격하고 있는 것을 보았다. 왕이 라기스를 떠났다는 소식을 들었던 것이다.
ko.R: 랍사게는 앗시리아 왕에게 돌아갔다. 그는 왕이 라기스 성을 떠났다는 소식을 들었다. 가 보니 왕은 립나 성을 치며 싸우고 있었다.

decisions.choice: Lachish and Libnah: fortified towns in the low hills southwest of Jerusalem
decisions.reason: Sennacherib had been besieging Lachish (18:14, 17). His palace carvings at Nineveh show the siege and capture of Lachish. Libnah lay a few miles to the north of it.

decisions.choice: he had heard: the Rabshakeh; he had set out: the king
decisions.reason: The Rabshakeh went back to Lachish, learned the king had moved on, and found him at Libnah.

decisions.choice: parallel to Isaiah 37:8
decisions.reason: The Hebrew of this verse is the same as Isaiah 37:8, and the wording here follows it.

decisions.choice: the Rabshakeh (L); the chief officer (B); the Assyrian commander (R)
decisions.reason: An Assyrian title (see 18:17). Literal keeps the title; Balanced and Readable give its sense.

source.text: וַיִּשְׁמַ֗ע אֶל־תִּרְהָ֤קָה מֶֽלֶך־כּוּשׁ֙לֵאמֹ֔ר הִנֵּ֥ה יָצָ֖א לְהִלָּחֵ֣ם אִתָּ֑ךְ וַיָּ֨שָׁב֙ וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח מַלְאָכִ֔ים אֶל־חִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ לֵאמֹֽר׃

fr.L: Et il entendit dire au sujet de Tirhaqa, roi de Koush : « Voici, il est sorti pour te combattre. » Et il envoya de nouveau des messagers à Ézéchias, en disant :
fr.B: Alors le roi apprit que Tirhaqa, roi de Koush, s’était mis en marche pour le combattre. Il envoya donc de nouveau des messagers à Ézéchias pour lui dire :
fr.R: Ensuite, le roi d’Assyrie a reçu des nouvelles de Tirhaqa, le roi de Koush, le pays qui est au sud de l’Égypte. Tirhaqa venait l’attaquer. Alors le roi d’Assyrie a de nouveau envoyé des messagers à Ézéchias. Il leur a dit :

vi.L: Vua nghe nói về Tiệt-ha-ca vua Cút: "Này, hắn đã ra để đánh ngươi." Vua lại sai sứ giả đến Ê-xê-chia, nói:
vi.B: Bấy giờ vua nghe tin Tiệt-ha-ca vua Cút đang kéo quân ra đánh mình. Vậy vua lại sai sứ giả đến Ê-xê-chia mà nói:
vi.R: Bấy giờ vua A-si-ri nhận được tin về Tiệt-ha-ca, vua Cút, xứ ở phía nam Ai Cập. Tiệt-ha-ca đang kéo quân ra đánh vua. Vậy vua A-si-ri lại sai sứ giả đến Ê-xê-chia. Vua dặn họ:

ko.L: 그리고 그가 구스 왕 디르하가에 대하여 "보십시오, 그가 임금님과 싸우러 나왔습니다" 하는 말을 들었다. 그러자 그가 다시 히스기야에게 사자들을 보내며 말했다.
ko.B: 그때 앗시리아 왕은 구스 왕 디르하가가 자기와 싸우려고 나왔다는 소식을 들었다. 그래서 그는 다시 히스기야에게 사자들을 보내며 말했다.
ko.R: 그때 앗시리아 왕은 구스 왕 디르하가에 대한 소식을 들었다. 구스는 이집트 남쪽에 있는 나라였다. 디르하가가 앗시리아 왕과 싸우려고 나오고 있었다. 그래서 앗시리아 왕은 다시 히스기야에게 사자들을 보냈다. 그는 사자들에게 말했다.

decisions.choice: Tirhakah king of Cush: a ruler of the Cushite kings who governed Egypt
decisions.reason: Cush lay south of Egypt on the Nile. Its kings ruled Egypt in this period. Tirhakah became king about 690 BC; in 701 BC he may have led the army as a prince, and the account gives him the title he later held.

decisions.choice: he returned and sent: he sent again
decisions.reason: "Return" joined to another verb often means doing something again. This is a second message, after the Rabshakeh's speech (18:19-35), now with a letter (verse 14).

decisions.choice: parallel to Isaiah 37:9, with "look" and "he returned" where Isaiah has "he heard"
decisions.reason: Isaiah 37:9 reads "he heard and he sent"; Kings reads "he returned and sent", that is, he sent again. Kings also adds "look" to the report about Tirhakah, and uses another word for "concerning". Both accounts describe the same second embassy.

decisions.choice: the land south of Egypt
decisions.reason: Readable explains where Cush was.

decisions.choice: again
decisions.reason: Every level gives the sense of "returned and sent"; read word for word it could suggest the king went home.

decisions.choice: "Tirhaca, rey de Cus"; "volvió a enviar"
decisions.reason: The usual Spanish forms; every level gives the sense of "returned and sent", as the English does (m2).

decisions.choice: Tirhaqa, roi de Koush
decisions.reason: French keeps the Hebrew name of the land, Koush, as the English keeps Cush; Readable explains where it was.

records.literal_gloss: Thus you will say to Hezekiah king of Judah, saying: Let not deceive you your God in whom you [are] trusting, saying, Not will be given Jerusalem into [the] hand of [the] king of Assyria.

en.L: "Thus you will speak to Hezekiah king of Judah, saying: 'Do not let your God, in whom you are trusting, deceive you, saying, "Jerusalem will not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria."
en.B: "Say this to Hezekiah king of Judah: 'Do not let your God, the one you rely on, deceive you by saying, "Jerusalem will not be handed over to the king of Assyria."
en.R: "Tell King Hezekiah of Judah this: 'You trust in your God. He tells you that Jerusalem will not be handed over to the king of Assyria. Do not let {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} fool you.

es.L: «Así {{plural_you:hablarán|hablaréis}} a Ezequías, rey de Judá, diciendo: “No te engañe tu Dios, en quien confías, diciendo: ‘Jerusalén no será entregada en mano del rey de Asiria’.
es.B: «{{plural_you:Díganle|Decidle}} esto a Ezequías, rey de Judá: “No dejes que tu Dios, en quien confías, te engañe diciendo: ‘Jerusalén no será entregada al rey de Asiria’.
es.R: «{{plural_you:Díganle|Decidle}} esto al rey Ezequías de Judá: “Tú confías en tu Dios. Él te dice que Jerusalén no será entregada al rey de Asiria. No dejes que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} te engañe.

fr.L: « Vous parlerez ainsi à Ézéchias, roi de Juda : “Que ton Dieu, en qui tu te confies, ne te trompe pas en disant : ‘Jérusalem ne sera pas livrée dans la main du roi d’Assyrie.’
fr.B: « Dites ceci à Ézéchias, roi de Juda : “Ne te laisse pas tromper par ton Dieu, celui sur qui tu comptes, quand il te dit : ‘Jérusalem ne sera pas livrée au roi d’Assyrie.’
fr.R: « Dites ceci au roi Ézéchias de Juda : “Tu fais confiance à ton Dieu. Il te dit que Jérusalem ne sera pas livrée au roi d’Assyrie. Ne te laisse pas avoir par {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.

sw.L: "Hivi ndivyo mtakavyomwambia Hezekia mfalme wa Yuda, mkisema: 'Mungu wako unayemtumaini asikudanganye, akisema, "Yerusalemu haitatiwa katika mkono wa mfalme wa Ashuru."
sw.B: "Mwambieni Hezekia mfalme wa Yuda hivi: 'Usikubali Mungu wako unayemtegemea akudanganye kwa kusema, "Yerusalemu haitatiwa mikononi mwa mfalme wa Ashuru."
sw.R: "Mwambieni mfalme Hezekia wa Yuda hivi: 'Unamtumaini Mungu wako. Anakuambia kwamba Yerusalemu haitatiwa mikononi mwa mfalme wa Ashuru. Usikubali {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} akudanganye.

vi.L: "Các ngươi hãy nói với Ê-xê-chia vua Giu-đa thế này: 'Đừng để Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi, Đấng ngươi tin cậy, lừa dối ngươi mà nói: "Giê-ru-sa-lem sẽ không bị phó vào tay vua A-si-ri."
vi.B: "Hãy nói với Ê-xê-chia vua Giu-đa: 'Đừng để Đức Chúa Trời mà ngươi nương cậy lừa gạt ngươi khi bảo: "Giê-ru-sa-lem sẽ không bị nộp vào tay vua A-si-ri."
vi.R: "Hãy nói với vua Ê-xê-chia của Giu-đa: 'Ngươi tin cậy Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi. Ngài bảo ngươi rằng Giê-ru-sa-lem sẽ không bị nộp vào tay vua A-si-ri. Đừng để {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lừa ngươi.

ko.L: "너희는 유다 왕 히스기야에게 이와 같이 말하여라. '네가 의지하는 너의 신이 "예루살렘은 앗시리아 왕의 손에 넘겨지지 않을 것이다" 하고 말하며 너를 속이지 못하게 하여라.
ko.B: "유다 왕 히스기야에게 이렇게 전하여라. '네가 의지하는 너의 신이 "예루살렘은 앗시리아 왕에게 넘어가지 않을 것이다" 하고 말하며 너를 속이게 두지 마라.
ko.R: "유다 왕 히스기야에게 이렇게 전하여라. '너는 너의 신을 믿고 있다. 그 신은 예루살렘이 앗시리아 왕에게 넘어가지 않을 것이라고 너에게 말한다. 그러나 그에게 속지 마라.

decisions.choice: deceive you: Sennacherib now calls God himself a deceiver
decisions.reason: In 18:29-30 he warned against trusting Hezekiah; now he says the LORD's own promise is a lie. This is the insult Hezekiah lays before God (verses 14-16).

decisions.choice: saying: the promise is what God says
decisions.reason: The words about Jerusalem are presented as God's promise, given through Isaiah and repeated by Hezekiah (18:30).

decisions.choice: parallel to Isaiah 37:10
decisions.reason: The Hebrew of this verse is the same as Isaiah 37:10, apart from spelling, and the wording here follows it.

decisions.choice: "너의 신" with no honorific in Sennacherib's letter
decisions.reason: The king of Assyria calls Israel's God a deceiver (meaning decision m1); Korean marks his scorn by "신" and the plain verb, as in the Rabshakeh's speech.

source.text: הִנֵּ֣ה׀אַתָּ֣ה שָׁמַ֗עְתָּ אֵת֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשׂ֜וּ מַלְכֵ֥י אַשּׁ֛וּר לְכָל־הָאֲרָצ֖וֹת לְהַֽחֲרִימָ֑ם וְאַתָּ֖ה תִּנָּצֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, you have heard what have done the kings of Assyria to all the lands, by devoting them to destruction; and you, will you be delivered?

en.L: Look, you have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all the lands, devoting them to destruction, and you will be delivered?
en.B: You yourself have heard how the kings of Assyria dealt with all the lands, wiping them out. And you expect to escape?
en.R: You have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to every other country. They destroyed them completely. Do you think you will be saved?

es.L: He aquí que tú has oído lo que han hecho los reyes de Asiria a todas las tierras, destruyéndolas por completo, ¿y tú serás librado?
es.B: Tú mismo has oído cómo trataron los reyes de Asiria a todas las tierras: las destruyeron por completo. ¿Y tú esperas escapar?
es.R: Ya has oído lo que los reyes de Asiria les han hecho a todos los demás países. Los destruyeron por completo. ¿Crees que tú te vas a salvar?

fr.L: Voici, tu as entendu ce qu’ont fait les rois d’Assyrie à tous les pays, en les vouant à la destruction ; et toi, tu serais délivré ?
fr.B: Tu as bien entendu ce que les rois d’Assyrie ont fait à tous les pays : ils les ont anéantis. Et toi, tu y échapperais ?
fr.R: Tu as appris ce que les rois d’Assyrie ont fait à tous les autres pays. Ils les ont complètement détruits. Penses-tu que toi, tu seras sauvé ?

sw.L: Tazama, umesikia yale ambayo wafalme wa Ashuru wamezitendea nchi zote, wakiziweka wakfu kwa maangamizi, nawe utaokolewa?
sw.B: Wewe mwenyewe umesikia jinsi wafalme wa Ashuru walivyozitendea nchi zote, wakiziangamiza kabisa. Nawe unadhani utaokoka?
sw.R: Umesikia yale ambayo wafalme wa Ashuru wamezitendea nchi nyingine zote. Waliziangamiza kabisa. Je, unadhani wewe utaokolewa?

vi.L: Này, ngươi đã nghe điều các vua A-si-ri đã làm cho mọi xứ, tận diệt chúng; còn ngươi, ngươi sẽ được giải cứu sao?
vi.B: Chính ngươi đã nghe các vua A-si-ri đã đối xử thế nào với mọi xứ: họ tận diệt các xứ ấy. Thế mà ngươi mong thoát được sao?
vi.R: Ngươi đã nghe các vua A-si-ri đã làm gì với mọi nước khác. Họ đã tiêu diệt hoàn toàn các nước ấy. Ngươi tưởng ngươi sẽ được cứu sao?

ko.L: 보아라, 너는 앗시리아 왕들이 모든 땅에 한 일, 곧 그 땅들을 진멸한 것을 들었다. 그런데 너는 건짐을 받겠느냐?
ko.B: 앗시리아 왕들이 모든 나라를 어떻게 진멸했는지 너도 들었을 것이다. 그런데 너만은 살아남을 것 같으냐?
ko.R: 너는 앗시리아 왕들이 다른 모든 나라에 한 일을 들었다. 그들은 그 나라들을 완전히 멸망시켰다. 그런데 너는 구원받을 것이라고 생각하느냐?

decisions.choice: devoting them to destruction: destroying them completely
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used for putting a people under a ban of total destruction (Deuteronomy 7:2). Here it simply means utter destruction.

decisions.choice: and you will be delivered?: a scornful question expecting no
decisions.reason: The question has no question word; the tone makes it a taunt: you alone will escape?

decisions.choice: parallel to Isaiah 37:11
decisions.reason: The Hebrew of this verse is the same as Isaiah 37:11, apart from an object marker that has no effect on the sense, and the wording here follows it.

decisions.choice: "en les vouant à la destruction" (L); "anéantis" (B); "complètement détruits" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used for devoting a people to destruction (m1); in Assyrian mouths it means total destruction, which Balanced and Readable say plainly.

decisions.choice: wakiziweka wakfu kwa maangamizi
decisions.reason: The herem verb in the Samuel wording at Literal; Balanced and Readable say "destroyed completely".

decisions.choice: "진멸하다" (L, B); "완전히 멸망시키다" (R)
decisions.reason: The Samuel note's word for *ḥerem*; here a boast of total destruction, so Readable needs no word about devoting to God.

source.text: הַהִצִּ֨ילוּ אֹתָ֜ם אֱלֹהֵ֤י הַגּוֹיִם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שִׁחֲת֣וּ אֲבוֹתַ֔י אֶת־גּוֹזָ֖ן וְאֶת־חָרָ֑ן וְרֶ֥צֶף וּבְנֵי־עֶ֖דֶן אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּתְלַאשָּֽׂר׃

records.literal_gloss: Did deliver them the gods of the nations whom destroyed my fathers, Gozan and Haran and Rezeph and [the] sons of Eden who [were] in Telassar?

en.L: Did the gods of the nations deliver them, which my fathers destroyed, Gozan and Haran and Rezeph and the sons of Eden who [were] in Telassar?
en.B: Did the gods of the nations my forefathers destroyed rescue them, Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and the people of Eden in Telassar?
en.R: The kings before me destroyed the nations of Gozan, Haran, and Rezeph, and the people of Eden who lived in Telassar. Did the gods of those nations save them?

es.L: ¿Acaso los libraron los dioses de las naciones que destruyeron mis padres, Gozán, y Harán, y Resef, y los hijos de Edén que [estaban] en Telasar?
es.B: ¿Los libraron acaso los dioses de las naciones que destruyeron mis antepasados, Gozán, Harán, Resef y la gente de Edén que vivía en Telasar?
es.R: Los reyes que me precedieron destruyeron las naciones de Gozán, Harán y Resef, y a la gente de Edén que vivía en Telasar. ¿Acaso los dioses de esas naciones las salvaron?

fr.L: Les dieux des nations que mes pères ont détruites les ont-ils délivrées, Gozan, Harân, Retseph et les fils d’Éden qui [étaient] à Telassar ?
fr.B: Les dieux des nations que mes ancêtres ont détruites les ont-ils délivrées, Gozan, Harân, Retseph et les gens d’Éden à Telassar ?
fr.R: Les rois qui ont régné avant moi ont détruit les peuples de Gozan, de Harân et de Retseph, et les gens d’Éden qui habitaient à Telassar. Est-ce que les dieux de ces peuples les ont sauvés ?

sw.L: Je, miungu ya mataifa iliwaokoa, ambayo baba zangu waliyaangamiza, Gozani na Harani na Resefu na wana wa Edeni waliokuwa Telasari?
sw.B: Je, miungu ya mataifa ambayo babu zangu waliyaangamiza iliwaokoa, Gozani, Harani, Resefu na watu wa Edeni walioko Telasari?
sw.R: Wafalme walionitangulia waliyaangamiza mataifa ya Gozani, Harani na Resefu, na watu wa Edeni walioishi Telasari. Je, miungu ya mataifa hayo iliwaokoa?

vi.L: Các thần của các dân tộc mà tổ phụ ta đã hủy diệt có giải cứu được họ không, là Gô-xan, Cha-ran, Rết-sép và con cái Ê-đen ở Tê-la-sa?
vi.B: Các thần của những dân tộc mà tổ tiên ta đã hủy diệt có giải cứu được họ không, như Gô-xan, Cha-ran, Rết-sép và dân Ê-đen ở Tê-la-sa?
vi.R: Các vua trước ta đã tiêu diệt các dân Gô-xan, Cha-ran, Rết-sép, và dân Ê-đen sống ở Tê-la-sa. Các thần của những dân ấy có cứu được họ không?

ko.L: 내 조상들이 멸망시킨 민족들, 곧 고산과 하란과 레셉과 들라살에 있던 에덴 자손을 그 민족들의 신들이 건져 냈느냐?
ko.B: 내 조상들이 멸망시킨 민족들, 곧 고산과 하란과 레셉과 들라살에 사는 에덴 사람들을 그들의 신들이 구해 냈느냐?
ko.R: 나보다 앞선 왕들이 고산과 하란과 레셉 민족과 들라살에 살던 에덴 사람들을 멸망시켰다. 그 민족들의 신들이 그들을 구해 냈느냐?

decisions.choice: my fathers: the kings before me
decisions.reason: The word means ancestors, and here the earlier kings of Assyria, whether or not they were the speaker's own forebears.

decisions.choice: Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, Eden, Telassar: towns and lands in upper Mesopotamia conquered by Assyria
decisions.reason: Gozan lay on the Habor River (17:6) and Haran on the Balikh (Genesis 11:31). Eden is the land Assyrian records call Bit-Adini, on the upper Euphrates.

decisions.choice: parallel to Isaiah 37:12
decisions.reason: The verse matches Isaiah 37:12, except that "destroyed" is a different form of the same verb and Telassar is spelled slightly differently. The meaning is the same.

source.text: אַיּ֤וֹ מֶֽלֶךְ־חֲמָת֙ וּמֶ֣לֶךְ אַרְפָּ֔ד וּמֶ֖לֶךְ לָעִ֣יר סְפַרְוָ֑יִם הֵנַ֖ע וְעִוָּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Where [is] he, [the] king of Hamath and [the] king of Arpad and [the] king of the city of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah?

en.L: Where [is] he, the king of Hamath, and the king of Arpad and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah?'"
en.B: Where is the king of Hamath, the king of Arpad, the king of the city of Sepharvaim, of Hena, or of Ivvah?'"
en.R: Where is the king of Hamath now? Where are the kings of Arpad, Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah?'"

es.L: ¿Dónde [está] el rey de Hamat, y el rey de Arfad, y el rey de la ciudad de Sefarvaim, de Hena y de Iva?”».
es.B: ¿Dónde está el rey de Hamat, el rey de Arfad, el rey de la ciudad de Sefarvaim, de Hena o de Iva?”».
es.R: ¿Dónde está ahora el rey de Hamat? ¿Dónde están los reyes de Arfad, de Sefarvaim, de Hena y de Iva?”».

fr.L: Où [est]-il, le roi de Hamath, le roi d’Arpad, et le roi de la ville de Sepharvaïm, de Héna et d’Ivva ?” »
fr.B: Où est le roi de Hamath, le roi d’Arpad, le roi de la ville de Sepharvaïm, de Héna ou d’Ivva ?” »
fr.R: Où est maintenant le roi de Hamath ? Où sont les rois d’Arpad, de Sepharvaïm, de Héna et d’Ivva ?” »

sw.L: Yuko wapi yeye, mfalme wa Hamathi, na mfalme wa Arpadi, na mfalme wa mji wa Sefarvaimu, Hena na Iva?'"
sw.B: Yuko wapi mfalme wa Hamathi, mfalme wa Arpadi, mfalme wa mji wa Sefarvaimu, wa Hena au wa Iva?'"
sw.R: Yuko wapi sasa mfalme wa Hamathi? Wako wapi wafalme wa Arpadi, Sefarvaimu, Hena na Iva?'"

vi.L: Hắn ở đâu, vua của Ha-mát, vua của Ạt-bát, vua của thành Sê-phạt-va-im, Hê-na và Y-va?'"
vi.B: Vua của Ha-mát, vua của Ạt-bát, vua của thành Sê-phạt-va-im, của Hê-na hay Y-va giờ ở đâu?'"
vi.R: Vua của Ha-mát giờ ở đâu? Các vua của Ạt-bát, Sê-phạt-va-im, Hê-na và Y-va đâu rồi?'"

ko.L: 하맛 왕과 아르밧 왕과 스발와임 성의 왕과 헤나와 아와의 [왕], 그가 어디 있느냐?'"
ko.B: 하맛 왕, 아르밧 왕, 스발와임 성의 왕, 헤나와 아와의 왕이 어디 있느냐?'"
ko.R: 하맛 왕은 지금 어디 있느냐? 아르밧과 스발와임과 헤나와 아와의 왕들은 어디 있느냐?'"

decisions.choice: Hamath, Arpad, Sepharvaim: cities in Syria and beyond that Assyria had taken
decisions.reason: Hamath and Arpad were named in the Rabshakeh's speech (18:34; see also Isaiah 10:9). People from Sepharvaim and Ivvah were resettled in Samaria after its fall (17:24).

decisions.choice: of the city of: introduces Sepharvaim
decisions.reason: The word is read as "of the city". Some take it as the name of another town, Lair.

decisions.choice: parallel to Isaiah 37:13, with "where is he"
decisions.reason: Isaiah 37:13 has the plain word "where"; Kings has "where is he", pointing at the king of Hamath. The sense of the taunt is the same.

source.text: וַיִּקַּ֨ח חִזְקִיָּ֧הוּ אֶת־הַסְּפָרִ֛ים מִיַּ֥ד הַמַּלְאָכִ֖ים וַיִּקְרָאֵ֑ם וַיַּ֨עַל֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה וַיִּפְרְשֵׂ֥הוּ חִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And took Hezekiah the letters from [the] hand of the messengers and he read them, and he went up [to the] house of Yahweh and spread it out Hezekiah before Yahweh.

en.L: And Hezekiah took the letters from the hand of the messengers and read them, and he went up [to] the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and Hezekiah spread it out before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Hezekiah took the letter from the messengers' hand and read it through. He went up to the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and opened it out in the presence of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: The messengers handed Hezekiah the letter, and he read it. Then he went up to the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. There he opened the letter out flat in front of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y Ezequías tomó las cartas de mano de los mensajeros y las leyó, y subió [a] la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y Ezequías la extendió delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: Ezequías tomó la carta de manos de los mensajeros y la leyó. Subió a la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y la desplegó en presencia {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Los mensajeros le entregaron la carta a Ezequías, y él la leyó. Luego subió al templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Allí extendió la carta delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et Ézéchias prit les lettres de la main des messagers et les lut ; et il monta [à] la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et Ézéchias la déploya devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Ézéchias prit la lettre de la main des messagers et la lut. Puis il monta à la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et la déplia devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Les messagers ont donné la lettre à Ézéchias, et il l’a lue. Ensuite il est monté au temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Là, il a déplié la lettre devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Naye Hezekia akazipokea barua kutoka mkononi mwa wajumbe, akazisoma, akapanda [hata] nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, naye Hezekia akaikunjua mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Hezekia aliipokea barua kutoka mkononi mwa wajumbe, akaisoma yote. Akapanda kwenda nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akaikunjua mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Wajumbe walimpa Hezekia barua, naye akaisoma. Kisha akapanda kwenda hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Huko akaikunjua barua hiyo mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Ê-xê-chia nhận các thư từ tay các sứ giả và đọc, rồi đi lên nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và Ê-xê-chia trải nó ra trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Ê-xê-chia nhận bức thư từ tay các sứ giả và đọc hết. Vua đi lên nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và mở bức thư ra trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Các sứ giả trao bức thư cho Ê-xê-chia, và vua đọc thư. Rồi vua đi lên đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Tại đó vua trải bức thư ra trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 그리고 히스기야가 사자들의 손에서 편지들을 받아 읽고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집으로 올라가서, 히스기야가 그것을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에 펼쳐 놓았다.
ko.B: 히스기야는 사자들의 손에서 편지를 받아 읽었다. 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집으로 올라가서 그 편지를 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에 펼쳐 놓았다.
ko.R: 사자들이 히스기야에게 편지를 건네주자 그는 그것을 읽었다. 그리고 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전으로 올라갔다. 그는 거기에서 그 편지를 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에 펼쳐 놓았다.

decisions.choice: the letters ... read them ... spread it out: one letter, written as a plural
decisions.reason: The noun and the first pronoun are plural, but "spread it out" is singular, so it is one document, perhaps of several sheets. Isaiah 37:14 reads "read it" where Kings reads "read them".

decisions.choice: spread it out before the LORD: laid the letter open in the temple as a plea
decisions.reason: Hezekiah puts the insults before God himself, as if presenting evidence to a judge, and then prays (verse 15).

decisions.choice: the letter
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use the singular, matching "spread it out"; Literal keeps the plural forms.

decisions.choice: "la carta"
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use the singular, matching "la extendió"; Literal keeps the Hebrew plural, as the English does (m1).

decisions.choice: akazipokea barua ... akazisoma ... akaikunjua
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew's plural "letters" and then singular "it" (meaning decision m1); Swahili "barua" can be either, and the agreement shows the change.

source.text: וַיִּתְפַּלֵּ֨ל חִזְקִיָּ֜הוּ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָה֮ וַיֹּאמַר֒ יְהוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ יֹשֵׁ֣ב הַכְּרֻבִ֔ים אַתָּה־ה֤וּא הָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ לְבַדְּךָ֔ לְכֹ֖ל מַמְלְכ֣וֹת הָאָ֑רֶץ אַתָּ֣ה עָשִׂ֔יתָ אֶת־הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וְאֶת־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: And prayed Hezekiah before Yahweh and said, Yahweh, God of Israel, sitting [on] the cherubim, you he [is] the God, you alone, of all [the] kingdoms of the earth; you made the heavens and the earth.

en.L: And Hezekiah prayed before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and said, "{{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, God of Israel, who sits [on] the cherubim, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} [are] {{deity_pronoun:he|He}}, the God, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have made the heavens and the earth.
en.B: Then Hezekiah prayed before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: "{{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, God of Israel, enthroned above the cherubim: {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, and no one else, are God of every kingdom on earth. It was {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} who made the heavens and the earth.
en.R: Then Hezekiah prayed to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. He said, "{{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, God of Israel, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} sit as king above the cherubim, the winged creatures over the ark of the covenant. Over all the kingdoms of the earth, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} alone are God. You made the heavens and the earth.

es.L: Y Ezequías oró delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y dijo: «{{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel, que estás sentado [sobre] los querubines, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} [eres] el Dios, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} solo, de todos los reinos de la tierra; {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} hiciste los cielos y la tierra.
es.B: Entonces Ezequías oró delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}: «{{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel, que reinas entronizado sobre los querubines: {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, y nadie más, eres Dios de todos los reinos de la tierra. Tú hiciste los cielos y la tierra.
es.R: Entonces Ezequías oró {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. Dijo: «{{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} reinas sentado sobre los querubines, los seres con alas que están sobre el arca del pacto. Solo {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres Dios sobre todos los reinos de la tierra. Tú hiciste los cielos y la tierra.

fr.L: Et Ézéchias pria devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et dit : « {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, Dieu d’Israël, qui sièges [sur] les chérubins, c’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui [es] le Dieu, {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} seul, de tous les royaumes de la terre ; c’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui as fait les cieux et la terre.
fr.B: Puis Ézéchias pria devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : « {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, Dieu d’Israël, {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui sièges au-dessus des chérubins, c’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, et nul autre, qui es Dieu de tous les royaumes de la terre. C’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui as fait les cieux et la terre.
fr.R: Puis Ézéchias a prié {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Il a dit : « {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, Dieu d’Israël, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} sièges comme roi au-dessus des chérubins, les créatures ailées qui sont sur l’arche de l’alliance. Tu es le seul Dieu de tous les royaumes de la terre. C’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui as fait les cieux et la terre.

sw.L: Naye Hezekia akaomba mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akasema, "Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, uketiye [juu ya] makerubi, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ndiwe Mungu, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} peke yako, wa falme zote za dunia; {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ndiwe uliyezifanya mbingu na dunia.
sw.B: Kisha Hezekia akaomba mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}: "Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, uliyeketi juu ya makerubi: {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, wala si mwingine, ndiwe Mungu wa kila ufalme duniani. Ni {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} uliyezifanya mbingu na dunia.
sw.R: Kisha Hezekia akamwomba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Akasema, "Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} umeketi kama mfalme juu ya makerubi, viumbe wenye mabawa walio juu ya sanduku la agano. Wewe peke yako ndiwe Mungu juu ya falme zote za dunia. Wewe ndiwe uliyezifanya mbingu na dunia.

vi.L: Ê-xê-chia cầu nguyện trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và thưa: "Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, Đấng ngự [trên] các chê-ru-bim, chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đức Chúa Trời, chỉ một mình {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, của mọi vương quốc trên đất; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã dựng nên trời và đất.
vi.B: Rồi Ê-xê-chia cầu nguyện trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}: "Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, Đấng ngự trên các chê-ru-bim: chỉ một mình {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, không ai khác, là Đức Chúa Trời của mọi vương quốc trên đất. Chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã dựng nên trời và đất.
vi.R: Rồi Ê-xê-chia cầu nguyện với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Vua thưa: "Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ngự làm vua trên các chê-ru-bim, là các thiên thần có cánh ở trên hòm giao ước. Chỉ một mình {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đức Chúa Trời trên mọi vương quốc của thế gian. Ngài đã dựng nên trời và đất.

ko.L: 그리고 히스기야가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 기도하며 말했다. "그룹들 [위에] 앉아 계신 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님, 주님만이 땅의 모든 나라의 하나님이십니다. 주님께서 하늘과 땅을 지으셨습니다.
ko.B: 그리고 히스기야는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 이렇게 기도했다. "그룹들 위에 왕좌를 두신 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님만이 세상 모든 나라의 하나님이십니다. 하늘과 땅을 지으신 분이 바로 주님이십니다.
ko.R: 그리고 히스기야는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 기도했다. "이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님께서는 언약궤 위의 날개 달린 그룹들 위에 왕으로 앉아 계십니다. 세상의 모든 나라 위에 오직 주님만이 하나님이십니다. 주님께서 하늘과 땅을 만드셨습니다.

decisions.choice: he prayed: the prayer of verses 15-19, parallel to Isaiah 37:15-20
decisions.reason: Kings joins in one verse what Isaiah 37:15-16 gives in two. Kings reads "prayed before the LORD and said" where Isaiah reads "prayed to the LORD, saying", and it lacks "of hosts" after the divine name in the address. The rest of the verse is the same. The prayer praises God, asks him to listen, states the danger, and asks for rescue so that the world may know him.

decisions.choice: who sits on the cherubim: enthroned above the winged figures over the ark
decisions.reason: Two golden cherubim spread their wings over the ark in the most holy place, and God was pictured as seated above them as king (Exodus 25:18-22; 1 Samuel 4:4; Psalm 99:1). The verb can mean to sit or to be enthroned.

decisions.choice: you alone are God: the LORD is the only God and the Maker of all things
decisions.reason: Against Sennacherib's claim that no god could resist him (verses 10-13), Hezekiah confesses that the LORD alone is God over every kingdom, because he made heaven and earth (Isaiah 44:24; 45:5-7).

decisions.choice: the winged creatures over the ark of the covenant
decisions.reason: Readable explains the cherubim.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}" without article in address; "los querubines"
decisions.reason: When Yahweh is addressed, the span has no article, as in the published Spanish Psalms; "querubines" as the terms note sets, explained at Readable as the English does.

decisions.choice: "SEIGNEUR" in the vocative without the article; "tu" to God
decisions.reason: As the Samuel note sets, the LORD addressed directly is the divine_name span without the article; God is addressed with "tu" and its pronouns take the deity_pronoun span.

decisions.choice: deity pronoun span on "wewe" addressed to God
decisions.reason: In prayer God is addressed with "wewe"; the free pronoun takes the deity pronoun span, as in the Swahili Psalms, and a pronoun at the start of a sentence after a full stop is written plainly ("Wewe ndiwe uliyezifanya").

decisions.choice: Lạy CHÚA; Ngài; chúng con
decisions.reason: Hezekiah prays in the forms of the earlier notes: "Lạy" in address, "Ngài" (with the deity_pronoun span) for God, "con" or "chúng con" for himself and his people.

decisions.choice: Hezekiah prays in the formal style (합쇼체), addressing God as "주여" (with the divine_name span) and "주님"
decisions.reason: As the Psalms note sets for prayer: 합쇼체 with "주님" for "you"; Korean has no free pronoun for God, so there are no deity_pronoun spans.

source.text: הַטֵּ֨ה יְהוָ֤ה׀אָזְנְךָ֙ וּֽשֲׁמָ֔ע פְּקַ֧ח יְהוָ֛ה עֵינֶ֖יךָ וּרְאֵ֑ה וּשְׁמַ֗ע אֵ֚ת דִּבְרֵ֣י סַנְחֵרִ֔יב אֲשֶׁ֣ר שְׁלָח֔וֹ לְחָרֵ֖ף אֱלֹהִ֥ים חָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Incline, Yahweh, your ear and hear; open, Yahweh, your eyes and see; and hear the words of Sennacherib, who has sent him to taunt [the] God living.

en.L: Incline, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} ear and hear; open, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} eyes and see; and hear the words of Sennacherib, who has sent him to taunt the living God.
en.B: Turn {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} ear, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, and listen; open {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} eyes, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, and look. Hear the words of Sennacherib, who has sent his envoy to insult the living God.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, please listen and hear. {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, open {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} eyes and see. Listen to what Sennacherib has said. He sent his officer to insult the living God.

es.L: Inclina, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} oído y oye; abre, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} ojos y mira; y oye las palabras de Senaquerib, que lo ha enviado para afrentar al Dios vivo.
es.B: Inclina {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} oído, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, y escucha; abre {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} ojos, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, y mira. Escucha las palabras de Senaquerib, que ha enviado a su mensajero para insultar al Dios vivo.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, por favor, escucha y oye. {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, abre {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} ojos y mira. Escucha lo que ha dicho Senaquerib. Envió a su oficial para insultar al Dios vivo.

fr.L: Incline, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} oreille et écoute ; ouvre, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} yeux et regarde ; et écoute les paroles de Sennachérib, qu’il a envoyé pour insulter le Dieu vivant.
fr.B: Prête l’oreille, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et écoute ; ouvre les yeux, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et regarde. Entends les paroles de Sennachérib, qui a envoyé son messager insulter le Dieu vivant.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, écoute, s’il {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} plaît, et entends. {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, ouvre {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} yeux et regarde. Écoute ce que Sennachérib a dit. Il a envoyé son officier insulter le Dieu vivant.

sw.L: Tega, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, sikio {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}, usikie; fumbua, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, macho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, uone; uyasikie maneno ya Senakeribu, aliyemtuma kumtukana Mungu aliye hai.
sw.B: Tega sikio {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, usikie; fumbua macho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, uone. Sikia maneno ya Senakeribu, aliyemtuma mjumbe wake kumtukana Mungu aliye hai.
sw.R: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, tafadhali sikiliza na usikie. Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, fumbua macho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} uone. Sikiliza yale aliyosema Senakeribu. Alimtuma afisa wake aje kumtukana Mungu aliye hai.

vi.L: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin nghiêng tai {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mà nghe; lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin mở mắt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mà xem; xin nghe những lời của San-chê-ríp, là lời hắn đã sai người đến sỉ nhục Đức Chúa Trời hằng sống.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin nghiêng tai mà nghe; lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin mở mắt mà xem. Xin nghe những lời của San-chê-ríp, kẻ đã sai sứ giả đến sỉ nhục Đức Chúa Trời hằng sống.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin lắng tai nghe. Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin mở mắt ra mà xem. Xin nghe những lời San-chê-ríp đã nói. Hắn đã sai viên chỉ huy của hắn đến sỉ nhục Đức Chúa Trời hằng sống.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님의 귀를 기울여 들으십시오. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님의 눈을 떠서 보십시오. 그리고 살아 계신 하나님을 조롱하려고 사람을 보낸 산헤립의 말을 들으십시오.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 귀를 기울이시고 들어 주십시오. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 눈을 뜨시고 보아 주십시오. 산헤립이 살아 계신 하나님을 모욕하려고 사신을 보내어 한 말을 들어 주십시오.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 제발 귀 기울여 들어 주십시오. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 눈을 뜨시고 보아 주십시오. 산헤립이 한 말을 들어 보십시오. 그는 살아 계신 하나님을 모욕하려고 자기 부하를 보냈습니다.

decisions.choice: incline your ear, open your eyes: asking God to take notice and act
decisions.reason: The same plea appears in Daniel 9:18. It does not suggest God is deaf, but asks him to treat the matter as his own.

decisions.choice: who has sent him: Sennacherib sent the Rabshakeh to taunt the living God
alternatives: the words which he has sent
decisions.reason: The words "to taunt the living God" repeat verse 4, where the Rabshakeh is the one his master sent. "Him" is most likely that envoy. Isaiah 37:17 reads "all the words of Sennacherib, which he has sent", without "him", which makes the words themselves the thing sent.

decisions.choice: parallel to Isaiah 37:17, without "all" and with "sent him"
decisions.reason: Isaiah 37:17 reads "all the words"; Kings lacks "all" and adds "him" to "sent" (see the decision above). The rest is the same.

decisions.choice: his envoy (B); his officer (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say who "him" is.

source.text: אָמְנָ֖ם יְהוָ֑ה הֶחֱרִ֜יבוּ מַלְכֵ֥י אַשּׁ֛וּר אֶת־הַגּוֹיִ֖ם וְאֶת־אַרְצָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Truly, Yahweh, have laid waste the kings of Assyria the nations and their land,

en.L: Truly, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, the kings of Assyria have laid waste the nations and their land,
en.B: It is true, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, that the kings of Assyria have devastated the nations and their lands,
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, it is true that the kings of Assyria have destroyed these nations and their lands.

es.L: Es verdad, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, que los reyes de Asiria han asolado las naciones y su tierra,
es.B: Es cierto, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, que los reyes de Asiria han devastado las naciones y sus tierras,
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, es verdad que los reyes de Asiria han destruido estas naciones y sus tierras.

fr.L: Il est vrai, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, que les rois d’Assyrie ont dévasté les nations et leur pays,
fr.B: C’est vrai, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, les rois d’Assyrie ont dévasté les nations et leurs territoires,
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, c’est vrai que les rois d’Assyrie ont détruit ces peuples et leurs pays.

sw.L: Kweli, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, wafalme wa Ashuru wameyaharibu mataifa na nchi yao,
sw.B: Ni kweli, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwamba wafalme wa Ashuru wameyaangamiza mataifa na nchi zao,
sw.R: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ni kweli kwamba wafalme wa Ashuru wameyaangamiza mataifa haya na nchi zao.

vi.L: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, thật vậy, các vua A-si-ri đã tàn phá các dân tộc và đất đai của họ,
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đúng là các vua A-si-ri đã tàn phá các dân tộc và đất đai của họ,
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đúng là các vua A-si-ri đã tiêu diệt các dân tộc ấy và đất đai của họ.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 참으로 앗시리아 왕들이 민족들과 그들의 땅을 황폐하게 했고,
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 앗시리아 왕들이 여러 민족과 그들의 땅을 황폐하게 한 것은 사실입니다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 앗시리아 왕들이 이 민족들과 그들의 땅을 멸망시킨 것은 사실입니다.

decisions.choice: the nations and their land: the peoples and the territory they held
decisions.reason: Isaiah 37:18 reads "all the lands and their land", an awkward phrase; Kings reads "the nations and their land", which is plain. Both describe the same devastation.

decisions.choice: truly: Hezekiah admits what Sennacherib said is true
decisions.reason: The facts are not in dispute (verses 11-13). The question is what they prove, which the next verse answers.

decisions.choice: Literal ends verse 17 with a connective ("황폐하게 했고,") and runs into verse 18
decisions.reason: As the English Literal, the sentence continues; Korean can end the verse on a connective ending, and verse 18 has its own content after the marker.

source.text: וְנָתְנ֥וּ אֶת־אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֖ם בָּאֵ֑שׁ כִּי֩ לֹ֨א אֱלֹהִ֜ים הֵ֗מָּה כִּ֣י אִם־מַעֲשֵׂ֧ה יְדֵֽי־אָדָ֛ם עֵ֥ץ וָאֶ֖בֶן וַֽיְאַבְּדֽוּם׃

records.literal_gloss: and putting their gods in the fire, for not gods [were] they, but [the] work of [the] hands of humankind, wood and stone, and they destroyed them.

en.L: and have put their gods into the fire, for they [were] not gods, but the work of human hands, wood and stone, and they destroyed them.
en.B: and have flung their gods into the fire. Those were never gods, only wood and stone shaped by human hands, so they could destroy them.
en.R: They threw the gods of those nations into the fire and burned them up. But those were not real gods. People had made them out of wood and stone. That is why the Assyrians could destroy them.

es.L: y han echado sus dioses al fuego, porque no [eran] dioses, sino obra de manos humanas, madera y piedra, y por eso los destruyeron.
es.B: y han arrojado sus dioses al fuego. Esos nunca fueron dioses, sino solo madera y piedra labradas por manos humanas; por eso pudieron destruirlos.
es.R: Echaron al fuego los dioses de esas naciones y los quemaron. Pero no eran dioses de verdad. La gente los había hecho de madera y de piedra. Por eso los asirios pudieron destruirlos.

fr.L: et qu’ils ont mis leurs dieux au feu, car ce n’[étaient] pas des dieux, mais l’ouvrage de mains humaines, du bois et de la pierre ; et ils les ont détruits.
fr.B: et ils ont jeté leurs dieux au feu. Ce n’étaient pas des dieux, rien que du bois et de la pierre façonnés par des mains humaines ; c’est pourquoi ils ont pu les détruire.
fr.R: Ils ont jeté les dieux de ces peuples dans le feu et les ont brûlés. Mais ce n’étaient pas de vrais dieux. Des hommes les avaient fabriqués avec du bois et de la pierre. C’est pour cela que les Assyriens ont pu les détruire.

sw.L: na kuitupa miungu yao motoni, kwa maana haikuwa miungu, bali kazi ya mikono ya wanadamu, miti na mawe; kwa hiyo wakaiangamiza.
sw.B: na kuitupa miungu yao motoni. Hiyo haikuwa miungu kamwe, ila miti na mawe yaliyochongwa kwa mikono ya wanadamu, kwa hiyo waliweza kuiangamiza.
sw.R: Waliitupa miungu ya mataifa hayo motoni, ikateketea. Lakini hiyo haikuwa miungu ya kweli. Watu walikuwa wameitengeneza kwa miti na mawe. Ndiyo sababu Waashuru waliweza kuiangamiza.

vi.L: và đã ném các thần của họ vào lửa, vì chúng không phải là thần, nhưng là công việc của tay loài người, gỗ và đá; vì thế họ đã hủy diệt chúng.
vi.B: và đã quăng các thần của họ vào lửa. Đó chẳng phải là thần, chỉ là gỗ và đá do tay người làm ra, nên họ đã hủy diệt được.
vi.R: Họ đã ném các thần của những dân tộc ấy vào lửa và thiêu rụi. Nhưng đó không phải là thần thật. Người ta đã làm ra chúng bằng gỗ và đá. Vì thế người A-si-ri mới hủy diệt được chúng.

ko.L: 그들의 신들을 불 속에 던졌습니다. 그것들은 신이 아니라 사람의 손으로 만든 것, 나무와 돌이었기 때문에, 그들이 그것들을 멸할 수 있었습니다.
ko.B: 그들의 신들을 불 속에 던져 넣었습니다. 그러나 그것들은 신이 아니라 사람의 손으로 다듬은 나무와 돌일 뿐이었으므로, 그들이 그것들을 없앨 수 있었습니다.
ko.R: 그들은 그 민족들의 신들을 불 속에 던져 태워 버렸습니다. 그러나 그것들은 참 신이 아니었습니다. 사람들이 나무와 돌로 만든 것이었습니다. 그래서 앗시리아 사람들이 그것들을 없앨 수 있었습니다.

decisions.choice: not gods, but the work of human hands: idols have no power of their own
decisions.reason: The prophets mock idols as things made by craftsmen (Isaiah 2:8; 40:19-20; 44:9-20). Their defeat proves nothing about the LORD, who made the heavens and the earth (verse 15).

decisions.choice: and have put: a finite verb continuing verse 17
decisions.reason: Kings has "they have put"; Isaiah 37:19 has an infinitive carrying on the verb of the verse before. The meaning is the same, and the rest of the verse matches.

decisions.choice: burned them up; That is why the Assyrians could destroy them
decisions.reason: Readable names the subject and spells out that the gods could be destroyed because they were only objects.

source.text: וְעַתָּה֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ הוֹשִׁיעֵ֥נוּ נָ֖א מִיָּד֑וֹ וְיֵֽדְעוּ֙ כָּל־מַמְלְכ֣וֹת הָאָ֔רֶץ כִּ֥י אַתָּ֛ה יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֖ים לְבַדֶּֽךָ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And now, Yahweh our God, save us, please, from his hand, and may know all [the] kingdoms of the earth that you, Yahweh, [are] God alone.

en.L: And now, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} our God, save us, please, from his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, [are] God alone."
en.B: So now, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} our God, please rescue us from his power, so that every kingdom on earth will know that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, alone are God."
en.R: Now, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} our God, please save us from the king of Assyria. Then all the kingdoms of the earth will know that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} alone, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, are God."

es.L: Ahora pues, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios nuestro, sálvanos, te ruego, de su mano, para que todos los reinos de la tierra sepan que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, [eres] el único Dios».
es.B: Así que ahora, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios nuestro, te ruego que nos libres de su poder, para que todos los reinos de la tierra sepan que solo {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, eres Dios».
